provenance.scope: Latest five uploads on the channel Videos tab as checked 2026-09-14; excludes Shorts and Live.
provenance.numeric_values: Our authored starting suggestions, not settings measured or extracted from IMPACT 3D.
provenance.review_method: Direct visual inspection of 335 detected-interval midpoint samples across five cached review videos; supplements an earlier 120 uniform samples. Not continuous playback or an audio review.

application_contract.lighting_changes: Only approved existing-light and environment controls in a versioned working copy. Appearance and reflections will change under relighting; shader parameters must not.
application_contract.atmosphere: Preserve existing state; add no fog, mist, weather or particles by default.
application_contract.effects_and_audio: Preserve approved effects only; no new flare, grain, sound or music from this catalogue.
application_contract.sun_direction: Approve world-space direction from actual site/camera/occluders; never attach it to the moving camera. Preserve existing light animation unless a replacement is explicitly approved.
application_contract.shared_chapter_state: Same approved world lighting for related shots; no automatic per-frame white balance or exposure.
application_contract.lighting_basis: Do not silently substitute Sun/Sky for HDRI or vice versa; avoid a duplicate sun in the HDRI plus analytic light.
application_contract.null_semantics: Unresolved or deliberately not prescribed; null is not zero, off, or permission to invent a value.
application_contract.numeric_semantics: Start values and ranges are calibration suggestions, not direct MAXScript property names or automatic commands.
application_contract.contrast_metric: Optional lit-to-shaded diffuse illumination ratio. Compare equivalent neutral diffuse surfaces or a supported irradiance diagnostic in scene-linear values. Not a VRayLight multiplier or display-code-value ratio; do not alter albedo to hit it.
application_contract.practical_cct: Kelvin suggestions apply only to mapped practical lights with a supported temperature mode; never to VRaySun or by relabelling an HDRI.
application_contract.source_geometry_changes: Sun direction, light size/position, environment orientation or shadow-pattern changes require a native rerender.
application_contract.lightmix: Only saved-pass intensity/colour/on-off exploration; verify complete contributors and renderer compatibility. Large changes require scene reconciliation and a rerender.
application_contract.final_picture: Every required frame is natively rendered at approved 4K dimensions, step 1, same source timebase. No Runway generation, AI upscale, optical flow or invented frames.

presets.name: Original Scene
presets.purpose: No relight; retain or restore the audited baseline.
presets.eligibility: Requires captured baseline for restore; never reconstruct original settings from defaults.

presets.name: Clear Neutral Daylight
presets.purpose: Bright readable architecture, clean stone and natural water/planting colour.

settings.sun_colour: Physical sky-model response; no forced orange filter.
settings.sky_fill: Existing coherent daylight environment, calibrated to keep shade readable.
settings.intensity: Start at existing scene values and units; calibrate after scene audit.

presets.eligibility: Existing compatible daylight rig. Preserve existing sun position instead if site/time fidelity is locked.
presets.grade_pair: Neutral daylight; retain cream/white distinctions and restrain blue-green saturation.
reject_if: white facade texture clips
foliage becomes neon
sun and reflection direction conflict

presets.name: Dappled Garden Backlight
presets.purpose: Layered planting, rim-lit leaves and readable paths beneath existing canopy.

settings.key_direction: Side/back direction chosen once in world space for the actual hero view and existing occluders.
settings.sky_fill: Natural open-sky fill; keep shaded planting distinct.
settings.intensity: Use actual calibrated daylight rig; no universal multiplier.

presets.eligibility: Existing vegetation or architectural occluders can cast the required pattern. Otherwise mark unavailable.
presets.grade_pair: Neutral-to-warm daylight; differentiate greens without repainting foliage.
reject_if: new foliage or shadow cards are required
leaf noise shimmers
shadow pattern changes between adjacent frames

presets.name: Golden Low Sun
presets.purpose: Warm grazing light, long shadows and silhouette separation.

settings.sun_colour: Low-elevation response of the verified physical sky; do not assign Sun Kelvin.
settings.sky_fill: Restrained cooler environment with useful shadow detail.
settings.intensity: Retain physical rig baseline, then calibrate existing sources for the approved exposure.

presets.eligibility: Existing rig can produce low sun without contradicting a locked geographical/time requirement. Dawn versus dusk is not inferred from the image.
presets.grade_pair: Warm highlights, restrained olive greens and neutral recoverable stone.
reject_if: warm grade changes every material to orange
glazing highlights clip
golden appearance is achieved only by global tint

presets.name: Soft Window Interior
presets.purpose: Soft neutral daylight across pale walls, upholstery and stone.

settings.key_direction: Existing window/sky aperture; keep the broad luminous opening physically motivated.
settings.shadow_softness: Broad environment/window illumination. No automatic new fill cards.
settings.practical_scope: Only existing fixtures selected to remain on, subordinate to window daylight.
settings.intensity: Balance existing sources without changing camera exposure or surface albedo.

presets.eligibility: Existing openings and rig provide soft window illumination; suppressing or changing direct sun needs an explicit previewed lighting variant.
presets.grade_pair: Clean cream/white balance and gentle highlight rolloff; do not bleach wood grain.
reject_if: room becomes evenly flat
window is replaced by a white card
curtains or glass materials are altered to increase transmission

presets.name: Warm Raking Interior
presets.purpose: Warm shafts or patches through real openings that reveal floor, fabric and wall relief.

settings.key_direction: Through the existing aperture, grazing the intended existing surface; approve once in world coordinates.
settings.practical_scope: Existing accent fixtures only; below the daylight key.
settings.intensity: Calibrate existing sun/sky and fixture groups; no universal lumens.

presets.eligibility: The actual window geometry and orientation admit the desired light. No new windows, gobos or atmospheric volume.
presets.grade_pair: Local warmth on lit surfaces; retain neutral shaded stone and detailed highlights.
reject_if: light appears to pass through opaque walls
sun patch slides because light tracks camera
materials are recoloured to simulate lighting

presets.name: Warm Practical Luxury
presets.purpose: Warm, layered lobby, lounge, banquet or spa lighting from existing fixtures.

settings.key_direction: Existing chandelier, cove, wall-wash or decorative fixture locations.
settings.shadow_softness: Preserve physical emitter dimensions and existing photometric distribution.
settings.practical_scope: Map cove, accent, decorative and general fixtures separately.
settings.intensity: Retain fixture units/IES; calibrate by visible contribution, not equal multipliers.
settings.daylight: Keep existing visible window environment coherent and subordinate where appropriate.

presets.eligibility: Existing fixture network provides the required lighting; no automatic hidden lights or edits to emissive material parameters.
presets.grade_pair: Cream, gold and wood separation; warm pools rather than an overall orange cast.
reject_if: light strips lose shape in clipping
all fixture types have identical brightness
dark wood loses texture

presets.name: Blue Hour and Warm Practicals
presets.purpose: Cool exterior ambience balanced with warm occupied interiors and landscape fixtures.

settings.sun_condition: No above-horizon direct sun; verify below-horizon behaviour of the actual sky model.
settings.environment: Compatible existing twilight sky/HDRI. If missing, block and request a separate environment choice; do not fetch or substitute one.
settings.practical_scope: Existing interior, facade and landscape fixtures; do not force pools, RGB sources or sports floodlights to this CCT.
settings.intensity: Balance actual practicals against environment; preserve coherent illumination and reflections.

presets.eligibility: Twilight-capable existing rig and the required actual fixtures are present. Otherwise unavailable.
presets.grade_pair: Cool ambient/warm practical separation, readable facade shadows; keep blue tint off neutral interiors.
reject_if: warm fixtures appear without corresponding lights
environment is black while reflections show daytime
weak LightMix passes become noisy

presets.name: Low-Key Material Detail
presets.purpose: Controlled grazing or reflected highlights on existing metal, stone, glass and fabric details.

settings.key_direction: Use the existing window or fixture angle to reveal surface relief and edges in the unchanged shot.
settings.shadow_softness: Source shape should describe curvature without a broad clipped reflection.
settings.intensity: Retain existing source colour; calibrate mapped key/ambient contributions and keep meaningful dark detail.

presets.eligibility: The saved camera already contains a suitable detail view and existing sources can provide separation.
presets.grade_pair: Deeper contrast with protected texture, glints and original material hue; no automatic vignette.
reject_if: roughness is changed to fake highlights
microtexture is denoised away
exposure is animated to follow highlights

presets.name: Theatrical Studio Specialty
presets.purpose: Isolated hero-object highlights and a dark surround, based on the separate Riviera Crown prologue.

settings.key_direction: Existing studio key and rim fixtures only, with approved source shaping.
settings.practical_scope: Here the CCT field applies to supported existing studio area lights, not scene practical architecture fixtures.
settings.intensity: Calibrate existing studio key/rim/background groups. No automatic environment blackout.

presets.eligibility: Unavailable unless the original scene already contains a suitable studio/set and hero object. Do not add chess pieces, backdrop, fog or architecture.
presets.grade_pair: Controlled near-black background with separated specular edges; preserve existing accent colours.
reject_if: used as a default grade for an ordinary daylight building
new set geometry or sources are required
black crush erases the hero object's shape
